schema_note: A minimal record for a Tesseract fine-tune, defined in release/README.md (R6). heocr_engine_training_run.v1 does not fit: it describes ketos runs made by heocr-engine train-kraken, its init must be from_scratch or a fine-tune of a project recognizer with its own record, its data must be a hocrsyngen batch (annotations and generation-manifest sha256), and its text_order assumes kraken's display-order reordering. R6, R7 and R8b are lstmtraining runs from a third-party base model (tessdata_best, through R7 for R8b) on real scanned and other lines, run by hand from task scripts. This record keeps the same top-level sections where they apply and has no local paths; <placeholders> stand for local files.

from_model.name: HeOCR R7
from_model.note: the checkpoint R7 was packed from; R7 is itself a fine-tune of the base below

starter_traineddata.name: the R8 starter (R6's and R7's starter plus ׳ ״ —)
starter_traineddata.unicharset: the base's LSTM unicharset plus U+05BE (maqaf), U+2013 (en dash), U+05F3 (geresh), U+05F4 (gershayim) and U+2014 (em dash): 74 unicharset entries, 73 codes; lstm-unicharset sha256 fd56926d9c3e2c37faa1f90d4f6960c5ac9ced92f03d326f72b03c1ecdd481a7
starter_traineddata.dictionary: the base's own word list (70,171 entries, recovered with dawg2wordlist), rebuilt with combine_lang_model --lang_is_rtl, norm mode 2; lstm-word-dawg sha256 a618186eb88789a203c2475ec30fbe2277427f97d063a8bf91cc564c0a166649
starter_traineddata.note: R7's starter was 8b9d798a…; R8a, the S17a A/B arms and R8b use this one

line_sets.name: bynli_lines_v2
line_sets.note: R7's 95,151 lines plus the 145 lines with ׳ ״ — that R7's starter could not represent; built by hocrgen 1921bbe (docs/f8f_r7_handoff.md)

line_sets.name: bynli_lines_v3
line_sets.note: hocrgen 93a413f (docs/f8f_r8_handoff.md); train minus Kevar and Yedi'ot ha-Teva (selection) and Zerubavel (overlap), minus 74 lines sharing a word 6-gram with a dev or scored set

line_sets.name: reshumotlines_v1
line_sets.note: hocrgen docs/reshumot_lines.md; 20,926 train lines minus 95 with characters outside the starter (Latin, mostly; 107 with the 12 dev lines), 347 sharing a 6-gram with reshumot dev and 951 sharing one with P-mod evaluation-booklet text (mostly date headers and enactment formulas)

line_sets.name: wslines_v1
line_sets.note: R8a trained on 3,812; 3,801 were dropped for R8b (line_verify Indexes)

line_sets.name: s17a_addon_v1.1
line_sets.note: synthetic; v1 minus 37 lines tied to the R8b selection books

labels.source: scanned book lines and synthetic lines: Project Ben-Yehuda edition text (books placed by the F8f alignment, never OCR output); Reshumot lines: the publisher's born-digital PDF text layer; Wikisource lines: the proofread transcription
labels.normalisation: NFC, logical order; niqqud removed; '…' as '...', '„' as '"', soft hyphens removed
labels.label_character_check: every label character is in the starter unicharset (build_lists.py asserts it)

gates.book_lines: as R7 (min alignment score 0.9, min line-OCR similarity 0.7, max height ratio 1.6, at most 6,100 lines per record, pointed prints dropped); bynli_lines_v3 also drops pointed spans in unpointed prints
gates.reshumot: born-digital check per booklet; hocrgen.split.eval_reserved.refuse_eval_reserved_training_input passes on all 19,533 rows (non_eval booklets only)

training_list_filters.script: task script build_lists.py (R8b), then eval's check_train_overlap.py drops
training_list_filters.order: seeded shuffle, seed 20261111 (lstmtraining reads a list in order)

selection.creators: Aaron Bernstein (d. 1884); translated by David Frischmann (d. 1922)

data.selection_bias: selection used 1,500 seeded lines of each selection book; the held-out figures use the other 4,600 lines of the same books, so they carry some selection optimism
data.conversion: each line's label is written in training order to <line>.gt.txt and a WordStr <line>.box, then commands.make_lstmf writes <line>.lstmf (R6-R8 make_lstmf.py); R7's and R8a's .lstmf files are reused for their lines

rights_verification.checked: 2026-11-12, every row of the training list, by line set
rights_verification.bynli_lines_v2: 95,296 rows: 19,820 NLI (7 records, free-use manifests) and 75,476 Internet Archive rows pointing to the 33 justifications R7 verified; all accepted, ids match
rights_verification.bynli_lines_v3: 62,808 rows: 2,319 NLI (Bachrach, free-use manifest, sha256 matches) and 60,489 Internet Archive rows in 14 books; every row's justification is accepted, its id matches, the book is pd_il (latest death 1946) and pd_us; 10 university-library scans and 4 Google scans retrieved via the Internet Archive
rights_verification.reshumotlines_v1: 19,533 rows in 48 booklets: PD-IL, born-digital check passed, eval-reserve guard passed
rights_verification.wslines_v1: 11 rows: justification accepted; text CC BY-SA 4.0 (decision 0016)
rights_verification.s17a_addon_v1.1: 18,627 rows: CC0; style sources a subset of R7's verified books

truth_order.training_order: Tesseract LSTM order: the logical line reversed as a whole, punctuation not mirrored, then each digit run (with internal . , : /) reversed back to left to right

rab.note: main plus rablines_v1 (old printed, rabbinic); not released: it tied main, lost on rendered Reshumot dev, and was dropped from the recipe (decision 0018)

hyperparameters.max_iterations_note: one epoch of the seeded-shuffle list
hyperparameters.eval_listfile_note: not set: lstmtraining's background tester thread crashed both arms (SIGSEGV in LSTMTester::RunEvalSync) on the first launches; selection runs afterwards on saved checkpoints and 20-minute snapshots

run.scheduler: both arms ran concurrently under HeOCR's power scheduler (AC power only)
run.voided_runs: two earlier launches (01:04 and 01:13) are void: list contamination found by eval's check, then the tester-thread crash

outcome.selection_rule: lowest CER under eval's line_fold_v1 profile (score_lines.py, every line charged) on the 3,000 selection lines, within arm main (rab dropped from the recipe)
outcome.superseded_selection: the first pick, by raw lstmeval BCER (iteration 139,700, model 9eee56cf…), was withdrawn after eval found two measurement problems (lines lstmeval drops, and inconsistent maqaf in the references); it ranks 8th of 28 under line_fold_v1

best_other_arm.note: 0.001 lower than main's pick on the selection lines; rab is not a release candidate (see hyperparameters.arms.rab)

outcome.validation_metric_definition: CER/WER %, eval-domains/scripts/score_lines.py, profile line_fold_v1; not hocrgen primary.v1

profile.name: line_fold_v1
profile.folds: ־→-, ׳→', ״→", “ ” „→", —→– (signs the references write inconsistently); NFC; whitespace collapsed

evaluation.test_score: none yet: no human-reviewed test set has scored R8b

olb_reshumot_dev.status: silver dev set used for the release decision; not a test score

selection_books_held_out.caveat: checkpoint re-selection (sel.list, 28 checkpoints) used lines from these same two books; margins carry selection optimism, and the Kevar margin over s17a-addon is small (-0.022)

brainin_v3.label: Brainin, IA scan (bynli_lines_v3 dev; R8c dev unit from now)

evaluation.s17a_addon: an unreleased A/B arm (R7 continued on R8a's lines plus the S17a add-on), reported for context
evaluation.brainin_ia_regression: Brainin IA: r8b-main-fold 0.743 vs R7 0.635 CER: R8b regresses on this scan (dark, fine-grained, small line height); R8c targets it, and it is R8c's dev unit, so not an unseen result for R8c

text_overlap_check.method: word 6-grams, Hebrew letters only, marks U+0591-U+05C7 stripped, NFC

eval_check_train_overlap.note: the 158 come mostly from R8a's train and the S17a add-on (agadothatanaim 45, kolsifreperetz 36, s17a 26) and Reshumot boilerplate (21); they flatter R8b on Brainin IA, Mekhilta and reshumot dev. The 13 OLB lines are Reshumot boilerplate and touch 11 dev lines; the gate's 'excluded' views leave those out

audit2_references.finding: one bynli_lines_v3 label (ia_afahleneemaniml00fngoog_c0102_l009) shares the rabbinic title formula אב"ד ור"מ דק"ק with reference page ws_index_381649__p0002; the method splits the three abbreviations into six tokens. Boilerplate, not shared text. R8b has no audit2 score

word_list_check.method: combine_tessdata -u, then dawg2wordlist with each model's own lstm-unicharset; sorted entry sets compared
word_list_check.replaces: a byte-identity check, which cannot pass: the dawg is rebuilt for a larger unicharset, so its bytes differ from the base's (as R7's did)
word_list_check.r8b_vs_tessdata_best: the same list in right-to-left order: reversed, the entries agree except 24 bracket or arrow tokens whose ( ) and < > are mirrored
word_list_check.decision: heocr-engine planning/decisions/0016-weights-trained-on-wikisource-transcriptions.md item 3 holds: no word list or dawg was built from Wikisource or any other training text

output.format: Tesseract traineddata, LSTM only (components: lstm, lstm-punc-dawg, lstm-word-dawg, lstm-number-dawg, lstm-unicharset, lstm-recoder, version)
